name: GSA (GSW=true) crossed with partner deal — no discount stacking
what_it_tests: A line that is both GSW__c=true and on a partner Deal_Type must apply GSA 50% ONLY and must NOT also stack the partner discount (D-04 notes 'no partner stacking' but no scenario crosses GSW×partner explicitly)
proc_mechanism: GSA Pricing (GSW=true) ListPrice*0.5 -> InputUnitPrice; Partner Discount must be gated off or its net write must not compound the GSA-halved price
expected_behavior: Net = ListPrice*0.5 (GSA); partner percent NOT additionally applied; net != 0.5*list*(1-partner%)
test_setup: GSW__c=true line, Deal_Type__c='Channel Originated' partner present, Qty=2, expect net = list*0.5 only

run3_result.actual: Quote 0Q0WC000003FO1u0AG QLI 0QLWC000003kbqs4AA (BoKS Perpetual, PBE list=355 USD, GSW__c=true, Deal_Type__c=Channel Originated, PartnerAccountId=001WC00000ZtazZYAR 15% discount): after Force-reprice V21 (isSuccess=true) -> UnitPrice=177.5 (=355*0.5 GSA fired), NetUnitPrice=301.75 (=355*0.85 partner on catalog list), Pre_Partner_Price__c=355, Base_Price__c=355. Stacked value would be 177.5*0.85=150.875 — NOT what was produced. NO STACKING confirmed. (Note: V21 in-place edits today changed the base from 20000 to 355 PBE list, but the no-stacking property holds: partner sees un-halved catalog price 355, not GSA-halved 177.5.)
run3_result.evidence: Hydrated probe QLI https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003kbqs4AA/view ; Quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FO1u0AG/view ; REST place returned isSuccess=true; SOQL post-reprice: UnitPrice=177.5, NetUnitPrice=301.75, Base_Price__c=355, Pre_Partner_Price__c=355. GSW restored to false after measurement.
run3_result.notes: V21 today vs run1: the pricing base changed from Source_List_Price (20000) to PBE catalog list (355) due to in-place V21 edits, so NetUnitPrice changed from 17000 to 301.75. The core no-stacking invariant is unchanged: GSA outputs to UnitPrice (InputUnitPrice track, ListPrice*0.5=177.5); partner outputs to NetUnitPrice using Pre_Partner_Price__c (catalog list=355, NOT the GSA-halved value), producing 355*(1-0.15)=301.75. Stacked would be 150.875. Actual 301.75 != 150.875 confirms no stacking. GS…
